title: Lists with range
hints: {{range .}}...{{end}} repeats its body for each element, with dot set to that element. {{if .}}...{{else}}...{{end}} checks whether the slice is empty.
Write the template as a raw string literal (backquotes) so real newlines are part of the output. Each line of the list is "- {{.}}" followed by a newline.
One answer: `{{if .}}Shopping list:` newline `{{range .}}- {{.}}` newline `{{end}}{{else}}Nothing to buy.` newline `{{end}}`
